recent_changes.description: Implemented in-car automotive GPS acquisition resilience: PRIORITY_HIGH_ACCURACY, 3-tier fallback (fresh GPS -> cached lastLocation -> hardware LocationManager), isLocationEnabled check, and atomic coroutine resumption.

Implemented AC Charging Flow Performance Optimization: Phase 01 (low-allocation mapping), Phase 02 (streaming HTML name resolution with 60m TTL cache), Phase 03 (progressive staged UI rendering with immediate candidate emit and async background enrichment).
Created telemetry benchmark documentation, station classification rules, updated API endpoints documentation and brain memory.

errors_encountered.error: LocationService PRIORITY_BALANCED_POWER_ACCURACY failed to acquire GPS fixes on car head units and Carlinkit TBox without Wi-Fi triangulation, and FusedLocationClient null responses bypassed lastLocation fallback.
errors_encountered.solution: Upgraded to PRIORITY_HIGH_ACCURACY, added immediate lastLocation fallback on null response, and integrated Android framework LocationManager enabled providers fallback.

errors_encountered.error: Blocking HTML scraping delayed AC station discovery UI by 2-3 seconds while holding full-screen loading spinners
errors_encountered.solution: Decoupled pipeline into 2 stages: Stage 1 emits candidate stations immediately (~300ms) with fallback names, turning off isLoading, while Stage 2 resolves canonical names asynchronously in the background

errors_encountered.error: Multi-megabyte HTML response buffering caused allocation spikes and GC pauses during batch name resolution
errors_encountered.solution: Refactored EvcsStationNameResolver to stream-parse title tags directly from OkHttp ResponseBody byteStream

decisions_made.decision: Adopt 2-Stage Progressive UI Rendering for Nearby AC Flow
decisions_made.reason: Eliminates spinner latency by displaying live port availability and fallback address names under 500ms, enriching station names asynchronously without scroll jumping

decisions_made.decision: Decouple acDiscoveryJob and acEnrichmentJob with clean cancellation guards
decisions_made.reason: Prevents in-flight AC enrichment jobs from leaking stale state or resolved names into other filter modes (e.g. DC or NONE)

decisions_made.decision: Stream-based regex title scraping with 60-minute in-memory TTL caching
decisions_made.reason: Avoids repeated network scrapes for the same stations and keeps peak memory low
